theorems.name: Submission.plane_disint_riesz_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (l : Filter ℝ) (m : ℝ → Measure (Grassmannian N n)) (D : Set C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), l.NeBot → (∀ᶠ ρ in l, IsProbabilityMeasure (m ρ)) → Dense D → (∀ f ∈ D, ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun ρ ↦ ∫ S, f S ∂(m ρ)) l (𝓝 c)) → ∃ η : Measure (Grassmannian N n), IsProbabilityMeasure η ∧ ∀ f : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ ↦ ∫ S, f S ∂(m ρ)) l (𝓝 (∫ S, f S ∂η))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
